costSource: AliExpress Canadian-gateway per-SKU price from window._d_c_ PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap on listing 1005008652215677, SKU 200000531:350852#E;249:200006305#Without Bulb: salePriceString C$28.21 against originalPrice C$28.60. That is a 1.4% gap, which is inside rule 22 - a standing price with rounding, not a promotion - so the sale figure is the cost basis. Contrast the tiered pendant, whose 38% gap makes the LIST price the basis. Not yet cross-checked against a DSers stable cost: the product does not exist in Shopify or DSers yet, and the DSers reading is the mapping step, not the sourcing step.
dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at CA$74.99, just under the CA$75.42 amazon.ca band median and CA$11.74 under the CA$86.73 RULE 2 ceiling. Contributes CA$31.69/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$15.46, the second-widest margin in the Canadian catalogue after the lantern. Supplier cost C$28.21 with a 1.4% list gap, so rule 22 is clear. Per-SKU stock 50 clears rule 4 (>= 25). Top competitor review count 255 in this basket, so the category is not locked. CAUTION: 21 sold on the listing, thinner than the 500-1,000+ behind the dome and saucer; per-SKU depth at 50 is what carried it, and 50 is not 5,771 - re-read stock before any paid push.
